tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// sngags kyi klog thabs 'bras bu 'byung ba'i me tog bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags bzlog par bzlas gyur na// dad med rnams la 'dod don med// dad pa yod kyang dngos grub ring*// de la klog thabs mdor bsdu na// ā li kā li gug skyed bcas// de la slob dpon ngag bzhin du// kha mig 'dris par yun ring bslab// klog thabs rim bzhin mi slob par// sngags 'bru rnams la 'di ci zhes// zer ba'i rgyu med 'bras 'dod pa// rmongs rnams yun ring don med 'gyur// a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ/ dbyangs yig bcu drug go /ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi'o// thog mar dbyangs yig bcu drug la/ a ni drang po i bkug pa// u ni smad pa zhes bya ste// de dag ring thung gnyis gnyis yod// ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ zhes bya ba// ma ning gi ni yi ge bzhi// de la ring thung gnyis gnyis yod// e ni bsgreng ba'i nga ro ste// ai ni bsgreng zhing bkug pa yin// o ni bstod pa zhes bya ste// au ni bstod de smad pa yin// aṃ ni sna ldan zhes bya ste// aḥni rnam par bcad pa'o// nga ro drang po las byung ba// ka nas brtsams te k+ṣa yi bar// gsal byed yi ge sum cu bzhi// skad gdangs yul gyi skad kyis dbyung*// gal te skad gdangs bcos pa na// rnar mi snyan cing brjod nor 'byung*// rgya skad phal cher lce rtse las// 'byung zhing brjod pa rab tu myur// skad gdangs mgrin pa phra zhing snyan// bod skad phal cher lce dbus las// 'byung zhing brjod pa dal ba yin// mgrin pa sbom gyur kha che dang*// ur+yan yul yang de dang 'dra// bod ni khyad par skad thung zhing*// ring thung khyad par 'ga' yang med// de la 'a med thung ba ste// thung dang drag po nor mi bya// ai e'i ra bklag pa ste// bsgreng zhing bkug pa yin phyir ro// au o'u gang du bris kyang rung*// o 'ur brjod de bstod smad phyir// sna ldan rnam par bcad pa yang*// ring bar sgrar ni brjod par bya// ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ṣa drug

/gha dzha dha bha k+ṣa ste lnga// de ltar yi ge bcu gcig po// bod la gtan nas med pa yin// rgya gar ba la'ang de dag la// yi ge log dang ha btags med// 'on kyang bod kyis brjod shes phyir// sngon gyi byang chub sems dpas mdzad// de ltar ta tha da na sha// lce rnal las 'byung de dag la// lce rtse bzlog ste brjod pa yis// ṭa ṭha ḍa ṇa ṣa rnams 'byung*// gha sogs ha btags yi ge lnga// ga ja ḍa da ba lnga la// ha sgra cung zad 'byung ba la// dgongs te ha btags yi ge mdzad// gha la 'kha' 'dra dzha 'tsha' 'dra// ḍha ni 'aṭh+ra 'dra dha 'tha' 'dra// bha ni 'pha' dang 'dra bar bklag /ha sgra mi gsal cung zad ldan// k+ṣa ni ka ṣa yin mod kyi// mi shes rnams kyis khya 'drar bklag /sha ṣa sa yi yi ge gsum// skabs kyis lce la gang bder bklag /ka tshan gyi ni klad kor nga*// tsa tshan nya yin ṭa tshan ṇa// ta tshan na yin de gsum ka /bod kyis nar brjod pa tshan ma// a dang k+ṣa yi klad kor rnams// ngar bklag pa ni mchog yin no// da ni brtsegs pa brjod par bya// dper na tiṣ+ṭha tis thra bzhin// gug skyed can gcig byung gyur na// phral te gug skyed kun la sbyar// dper na t+yu la tu yu 'am/ ṣ+ṭhi la ṣi thri ji bzhin no// gal te phral te klog pas na// ci phyir phral nas mi 'dri zhes// rgol na bod skad kyang mtshungs zhes// de gnyis khyad par med par bsgre// gsang sngags kyi ni rgyud rnams las// yi ge mang po brtsegs pa yod// de ni sa bon yin pa'i phyir// dus gcig mi brjod phral de brjod// tsa tsha dza la ya sta btags// bod kyis ca cha ja bzhin bklag /gug skyed can yang de bzhin te// dper na cayai tsa yi bzhin// ta tha da sogs ya sta byung*// e sgra ldan par phral zhing bklag /dper na t+yai ta ye bzhin// th+yai la the ye ji bzhin no// dz+nyā zhes bya ba'i yi ge la// bod kyis gnya' zhes bya bar bklag

/ṣ+ṇa ṣ+ṭa ṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba la// sha log sha rnal gang byung yang*// sa dang 'dra bar bya ba ste// snra s+t+ra s+thar zhes brjod pas 'grub// s+t+rai yā dh+wa lta bu la// s+t+rai'i yā dh+wa ru bklags pas 'grub// de la sogs pa bsam mi khyab// sngar gyi klog thabs ma shes na// 'dir mang bris pas ci zhig phan// de bas sngar brjod thabs la 'bad// sngags kyi klog thabs 'bras bu 'byung ba'i me tog ces bya ba lo tsā ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
